sections.h2: How the personal year is calculated
sections.html:
Add the digits of your birth month, your birth day and the year your current personal year began, then reduce to a single digit. Your personal year changes on your birthday, not on 1 January. For someone born on 14 March, from their birthday in March 2026: 3 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 0 + 2 + 6 = 18, and 1 + 8 = 9, so they are in a Personal Year 9 until March 2027. The calculator above handles the birthday for you.

Read your personal year alongside your Birth Number and Life Path: the year sets the weather, your core numbers describe how you tend to move through it. The personal year guide goes deeper.

• Years 1 to 3: start, partner, express. New projects and visibility.
  • Years 4 to 6: build, adapt, commit. Structure, change and responsibility.
  • Years 7 to 9: reflect, achieve, complete. Inner work, results and clearing space.

faq.q: What is my personal year in numerology?
faq.a: Add your birth month, birth day and the current year, then reduce to one digit. The result from 1 to 9 is your Personal Year Number.

faq.q: When does a personal year start?
faq.a: On NameAligned the personal year runs from one birthday to the next, so it changes on your birthday rather than on 1 January. The calculator takes this into account.
It is the completion year of the cycle: finishing, releasing and making space before a new Personal Year 1 begins.

faq.q: Is the personal year the same for everyone?
faq.a: No. It depends on your birth month and day, so people born on different dates are in different years of the cycle.
